### IRT Announces Dates for Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call


July 13, 2026


PHILADELPHIA--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Independence Realty Trust, Inc. (“IRT”) (NYSE: IRT) announces the release date and conference call details related to its second quarter 2026 financial results.


**Details:**


Results Release Date:


Monday, August 3, 2026, after the market closes


Conference Call Date and Time:


Tuesday, August 4, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time


Telephone Number (within the U.S.):


(833) 461-5787


Conference ID (Passcode):


379217423


The live conference call can also be accessed from the “Investors” section of IRT’s website,[https://investors.irtliving.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.irtliving.com%2Fcorporate-profile%2F%3F_gl%3D1*f0i8mi*_gcl_au*MzkyOTQ1ODI4LjE3Mzg2MTc2Nzg.*_ga*MTM1MjU3Mjc3OS4xNzM4NjE3Njc4*_ga_733QN6EE45*MTc0MzAxMjM2OC40Ni4xLjE3NDMwMTI1ODAuMTEuMC4w&esheet=54569167&newsitemid=20260713409206&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.irtliving.com&index=1&md5=14dda6340929e85dd98cde82af63ed1d) .


**Replay Information:**


Shortly after the live conference call concludes, a webcast replay will be available on the “Investors” section of IRT’s website,[https://investors.irtliving.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.irtliving.com%2Fcorporate-profile%2F%3F_gl%3D1*f0i8mi*_gcl_au*MzkyOTQ1ODI4LjE3Mzg2MTc2Nzg.*_ga*MTM1MjU3Mjc3OS4xNzM4NjE3Njc4*_ga_733QN6EE45*MTc0MzAxMjM2OC40Ni4xLjE3NDMwMTI1ODAuMTEuMC4w&esheet=54569167&newsitemid=20260713409206&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.irtliving.com&index=2&md5=04cce8576dd65a0995bff14703c6f6fd) .


**About IRT:**


Independence Realty Trust, Inc. (NYSE: IRT), an S&P 400 MidCap Company, is a real estate investment trust (“REIT”) that owns and operates multifamily communities, across non-gateway U.S. markets. IRT’s investment strategy is focused on gaining scale near major employment centers within key amenity rich submarkets that offer good school districts and high-quality retail. IRT’s main objective is to provide attractive risk-adjusted returns to shareholders through diligent portfolio management, strong operational performance, and a consistent return on capital through distributions and capital appreciation. More information is available at[www.irtliving.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.irtliving.com&esheet=54569167&newsitemid=20260713409206&lan=en-US&anchor=www.irtliving.com&index=3&md5=572bf7e55c3b34ecae34002a7e22310e) .
